description: Combine the packed vectorized n=2048 plus deterministic pair-local n=256 global-best stack with the queue-cached, separated-scheduler tight-prefix CuTe n=1024 winner. Import only the batch-60 compact staging, stage-view/pointer cache, scheduler, and queue wrapper; preserve n=2048 preparation/cleanup packing and isolated MathDx state, then validate cache resets, cleanup ordering, caller-stream policy, fresh inputs, and the full grid.

Imported only the queue-cached separated batch60 n1024 CuTe scheduler, tight-prefix compact staging, cached stage views and pointers onto the packed n2048 plus robust n256 parent, preserving its grouped preparation/cleanup and isolated MathDx state. Build, caller-stream/kernelguard gates, 17 official tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 benchmark shapes passed. Aggregate measured 936.432 us; n256 measured 127.359 us, batch60 n1024 2158.636 us, and batch8 n2048 2442.507 us.

Repacked the exact batch60 n1024 post-RankK upper cleanup from one 256-thread CTA per matrix row to eight rows per CTA with one warp per row, retaining vectorized float4 stores and leaving the packed n2048 preparation/cleanup unchanged. Build, policy gates, official tests, fresh-input guard, and all benchmark shapes passed. Aggregate improved from 936.432 to 935.517 us; target n1024 improved from 2158.636 to 2155.892 us, with n256/n2048 at 127.199/2417.629 us.

Extended the batch60 n1024 packed-row mapping to its initial lower-triangle float4 copy: eight rows per 256-thread CTA with one warp per row, retaining the packed upper cleanup, queue-cached CuTe stages, and all isolated n256/n2048 state. Build, policy, official tests, fresh-input guard, and full benchmark grid passed. Aggregate improved from 935.517 to 930.532 us; target n1024 improved from 2155.892 to 2140.988 us, while n256/n2048 measured 120.985/2388.298 us.

Specialized the three batch60 n1024 CuTe RankK launches at compile time for trailing sizes 768/512/256, fixed batch/strides, and retained only pointers plus the caller-current cached queue as runtime arguments. Packed input/cleanup and all n256/n2048 state remained unchanged. Build, policy, official tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Aggregate improved from 930.532 to 924.311 us; target n1024 improved from 2140.988 to 2123.947 us, with n256/n2048 at 120.567/2369.907 us.

Hoisted caller-current queue lookup and wrapper selection out of the three specialized batch1024 RankK stage calls, acquiring it once per Cholesky invocation while preserving caller-stream launch ordering. Build, policy gates, official tests, fresh-input guard, and all benchmark cells passed. Target n1024 measured 2138.336 us versus 2123.947 us with per-stage lookup; aggregate measured 933.916 us versus 924.311 us amid n256/n512/n2048 variance.

Bound each specialized batch1024 RankK callable and trailing output pointer into the cached stage table, dropping per-invocation stage indexing and unused trailing tensor views while retaining once-per-call caller-queue lookup. Build, policy gates, official tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Target measured 2137.133 us versus 2138.336 us before callable binding and 2123.947 us with the best per-stage queue lookup; aggregate measured 934.468 us amid unchanged-shape variance.

Removed the batch1024 path's scoped PyTorch TF32 flag save/set/restore while retaining FP32 TRSM and explicit FP16-input/FP32-accumulate CuTe RankK. Build, policy, official tests, fresh-input guard, and all benchmark cells passed, but target n1024 rose from 2137.133 to 2214.265 us, showing the scoped flag still affects this factor/solve sequence; aggregate measured 930.051 us amid faster unchanged cells.

Combined the packed n2048 plus robust n256 parent with the queue-cached, separated batch60 n1024 CuTe path across seven measured trials. Exact integration measured 936.432 us; warp-packed upper cleanup 935.517; adding warp-packed lower copy 930.532; compile-time specialization of the 768/512/256 RankK stages reached the best 924.311 us at 134a89f with target n1024 2123.947 us and n256/n2048 120.567/2369.907 us. Hoisted queue lookup, bound stage callables, and removed scoped TF32 state measured 933.916/934.468/930.051 us, with target 2138.336/2137.133/2214.265 us. Every trial passed build, caller-stream/kernelguard policy, 17 official tests, fresh-input guards, and all 15 benchmark cells. Local profiling was waived and hosted Brev was unavailable. Keep this line moving with a diagonal-macrotile masked epilogue that safely removes post-RankK cleanup, FP32-to-FP16 conversion folded into the CuTe mainloop, or stage-specific tile/cluster operators now that shape scalars are compile-time constants.
